g.title: MinVelRank2Convo2 begins.
g.text: MinVelRank2Convo2 begins.

g.title: j1056627125
g.text: Hey Minerva, um... what's your favorite color?

g.title: j2411538555
g.text: Minerva, can I ask you about Rusalka?

g.title: j315041261
g.text: Minerva, can I ask you about you and Velimir?

g.title: j1873047951
g.text: MomToxicated: Mitis Green. Manufactured in 1814 to be a pigment in the most beautiful of emerald shades.

g.title: j1468357726
g.text: MomToxicated: Seeing as our dear Velimir already gave away all of the classified information. Sure. Why not.

g.title: j2797981629
g.text: PapaPolar: (you do realize i'm, y'know, right freakin' here, right?)

g.title: j4096899886
g.text: MomToxicated: It is also extremely toxic, as it contains a high quantity of arsenic.

g.title: j1896057048
g.text: MomToxicated: You heard the story of how we adopted her.

g.title: j4197214314
g.text: Go get a drink?

g.title: j3003388962
g.text: (And you do realize you can, y'know, go away, right?)

g.title: j3707877761
g.text: Boolean MinervaColor is now true.

g.title: j3813007699
g.text: MomToxicated: Velimir told you how Neci wanted to join this religious fanatic cult masquerading as a mercenary outfit.

g.title: j3956952241
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j3922413848
g.text: PapaPolar: yeah, yeah, sure fine...

g.title: j2857376560
g.text: MomToxicated: Did you know that on its own, arsenic has no taste or smell? It disappears perfectly undetectable into water, medicine...

g.title: j3723510125
g.text: MomToxicated: And how I said no. How he said yes. And off she went.

g.title: j2728634633
g.text: PapaPolar: don't gotta tell me twice 8-D

g.title: j1045058274
g.text: PapaPolar: i'm sure M's only gonna say nice things about me, anyway.

g.title: j2799887432
g.text: MomToxicated: Pizza.

g.title: j1641521995
g.text: MomToxicated: What he probably didn't tell you, is the fact that I had just come back from a year-long black ops intel operation investigating Scaldra.

g.title: j2765277592
g.text: MomToxicated: Mmhm.

g.title: j1882382677
g.text: MomToxicated: Did you want to talk to me about something?

g.title: j95554289
g.text: MomToxicated: I didn't just have "a suspicion" about them, I had FACTS. Binders and stacks of floppy disks of FACTS.

g.title: j2333723520
g.text: Boolean MinervaVelimir2 is now true.

g.title: j3117984298
g.text: I'd like to ask you about you and Velimir.

g.title: j1577382047
g.text: I'd like to hear the story of you and Rusalka from your point of view.

g.title: j3702508370
g.text: Nah... I'm good. [End.]

g.title: j3741136198
g.text: MomToxicated: They're bought and sold for by some of the biggest corporations in this world. Ones whose corruption and greed run deep.

g.title: j2831384593
g.text: MomToxicated: Well. What do you want to know?

g.title: j1586934954
g.text: +20 Chemistry

g.title: j515143588
g.text: MomToxicated: We're talking "remake the world into their oligarchic dystopia" where us peasants live to serve them and rake the fields and kiss their golden feet.

g.title: j2552163128
g.text: How long have you two been together?

g.title: j1661273256
g.text: How did it fall apart between you two?

g.title: j2954456919
g.text: How did you two fall in love?

g.title: j2775449197
g.text: How did you two meet?

g.title: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo3.
g.text: Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo3.

g.title: j1586934954->Chat ends. Next chat will be MinVelRank2Convo3.
j188521182
g.text: MomToxicated: If you can imagine a hell like that.

g.title: j834124923
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j2368175674
g.text: MomToxicated: Well. Velimir told you some of it. I might as well tell you the rest from my side.

g.title: j3436048721
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j1571066612
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j1078492151
g.text: I'm following.

g.title: j869732018
g.text: Yeah. Let's say I have experience.

g.title: j550250628
g.text: MomToxicated: Anything else?

g.title: j655054802
g.text: MomToxicated: Especially as it has to do with Neci.

g.title: j4216043858
g.text: MomToxicated: Anything else?

g.title: j583470686
g.text: MomToxicated: Anything else?

g.title: j1200003430
g.text: Did you tell Velimir any of this?

g.title: j2703009565
g.text: Did you tell Rusalka any of this?

g.title: j1619060922
g.text: Uh... How did it fall apart between you two?

g.title: j4160136722
g.text: Uh... How did you two fall in love?

g.title: j2328121546
g.text: Uh... How did you two meet?

g.title: j3117102579
g.text: Uh... How long have you two been together?

g.title: j641697730
g.text: Uh... How did you two meet?

g.title: j3709205640
g.text: Uh... How long have you two been together?

g.title: j4176801512
g.text: Uh... How did you two fall in love?

g.title: j1207914823
g.text: MomToxicated: Couldn't. Classified. And I mean *classified.* They'd want names. Dates. Photographs. Hard proof. Just telling them this was going on, wouldn't be good enough.

g.title: j1847941182
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j1117061406
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j1415029923
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j2771306064
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j3102535116
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j456009916
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j2114670246
g.text: MomToxicated: And worse yet? If I told them who in each government structure was being bought and sold? They'd want to go put a stop to it.

g.title: j504326380
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j2586468644
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j2295956128
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j1893778499
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j3195464445
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j1328024959
g.text: MomToxicated: What else?

g.title: j1870517255
g.text: MomToxicated: They'd want to *fix* it. To go be the hero.

g.title: j4218725222
g.text: Um... How did it fall apart between you two?

g.title: j2647570402
g.text: Um... How did you two meet?

g.title: j3975240160
g.text: Um... How did you two fall in love?

g.title: j4286375454
g.text: Um... How long have you two been together?

g.title: j1710126489
g.text: Nothing wrong with being the hero.

g.title: j1520336397
g.text: You couldn't trust them?

g.title: j1749254088
g.text: MomToxicated: Classified.

g.title: j4098326240
g.text: MomToxicated: There is when it gets you killed. And look what happened to Neci. She's dead.

g.title: j703891145
g.text: MomToxicated: It's not that I didn't trust them. *They* didn't trust *me.*

g.title: j3110580836
g.text: MomToxicated: Are you sensing a pattern?

g.title: j572098208
g.text: Define "dead."

g.title: j2671276545
g.text: We don't know if she's dead.

g.title: j4092060331
g.text: MomToxicated: When you have a relationship with someone who works in... this kind of industry?

g.title: j4055639130
g.text: I'm getting the feeling I'd make a pretty lousy spy.

g.title: j1963657738
g.text: MomToxicated: Sigh.

g.title: j1372999892
g.text: MomToxicated: I know what she's not. She's not here. She's not safe. She's not herself.

g.title: j2272283525
g.text: MomToxicated: You need to trust the other person with more than your life.

g.title: j541394062
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j957100399
g.text: MomToxicated: Look, Drifter.

g.title: j2520205872
g.text: MomToxicated: You need to know that when they say "do this, and don't ask why, and don't ask details, just know everything depends on it, and I can't tell you anything more than that"?

g.title: j797585032
g.text: MomToxicated: I'm getting that sense, too. You poor thing. lol.

g.title: j72268798
g.text: MomToxicated: They mean it.

g.title: j2433737733
g.text: MomToxicated: I'll... throw you a bone. Tell you why he and I broke it off. From *my* side.

g.title: j1072612874
g.text: MomToxicated: The fact of the matter is, when I told Velimir and Neci - Not Scaldra. Not them. Anyone but them. Because of who is paying for them.

g.title: j1560912111
g.text: MomToxicated: I understood why Neci said that wasn't good enough. It wouldn't have been good enough for me at her age, either.

g.title: j344670001
g.text: MomToxicated: But Velimir? That...

g.title: j2646266842
g.text: MomToxicated: It was a stab in the back. One... that I couldn't forgive lightly.

g.title: j3950621704
g.text: MomToxicated: And now knowing what it cost our little girl...

g.title: j1131570809
g.text: MomToxicated: I can't tell if it'd be worse if she were just dead. But her mind? Her soul? Or... worse?

g.title: j4005215450
g.text: I wish I could make some kind of promise about finding her. Or saving her. But I can't. And I won't.

g.title: j263773036
g.text: Like I said, there's no knowing what's happened to her. Which means there's hope.

g.title: j3127606681
g.text: +5 Chemistry

g.title: j1845246946
g.text: MomToxicated: I didn't come here for hope.

g.title: j2286599146
g.text: MomToxicated: Good. And... that means I owe you an apology for how I've been treating you.

g.title: j3180685655
g.text: MomToxicated: But I do want to tell you I shouldn't have shot my mouth off at you from the start. We need to work together if we're going to find this Indifference and my Neci.

g.title: j2969852822
g.text: MomToxicated: You've got a soldier's head on your shoulders. And I shouldn't have dismissed that outright.

g.title: j2791749607
g.text: Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?

g.title: j3113712963
g.text: "Apology" accepted?

g.title: j481041585
g.text: Apology accepted.

g.title: j4264025688
g.text: Yeah, well. Ease off the *verbal* toxic spores next time, okay?

g.title: j2033789320
g.text: MomToxicated: Will do.

g.title: j3420015899
g.text: MomToxicated: Thanks.

g.title: j3147729283
g.text: MomToxicated: Heh. Will do.

g.title: j2174124952
g.text: MomToxicated: Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to go find that useless melted snowman before he's too drunk to drag back to his bunk or he starts shouting at the TVs again.
